name: fanzero
description: Publish games with FanZero and connect with influencers through launch visibility and revenue-share pacts.

interface.longDescription: Publish a complete game listing with media, platform-specific prices, monetization and influencer revenue-share offers. Link to the original online game by default. A hosted preview must faithfully represent it, be tested in FanZero's sandbox and offer an advantage over its direct link. Publishing approval does not authorize an offline adaptation. Includes a publishing skill; MCP connections are manual. Human curator review is required.
defaultPrompt: Check whether my game can be published on FanZero.
Prepare a FanZero listing and revenue-share offer for my approval.
Review my FanZero influencer proposals and their revenue-share dates.

publication.release_notes: Prefer original online game links and require verified quality evidence for hosted previews; support retiring a misleading preview.
